description.p: Cousoir works on the library of the Calibre ebook manager. It lists its books by title, author, series, tag, language and publisher, as a table or as covers, with each book's metadata, description and files. It edits their metadata and covers, adds books, moves them to the library's trash and back, and sends them to a Kobo or a Kindle.

Calibre stays the library's owner. Cousoir follows Calibre's own rules, ported from the code of Calibre, the free ebook manager by Kovid Goyal and the Calibre contributors, and Calibre itself converts the books and sends them to the readers. Cousoir is an independent project, not made or endorsed by the Calibre project.
